verdict.rationale: The axis applies: the RTX 5080 ships with UI surfaces (NVIDIA app for DLSS overrides and updates, G-Assist for system tuning), so a buyer could reasonably ask whether those controls are also exposed programmatically. Nothing in the evidence shows UI-to-API parity. The CUDA Toolkit is a compute-programming SDK, not an API mirroring the app's settings, and no API for the NVIDIA app or G-Assist functions is documented.
